summary:
I have investigated the issue and found that `app/scheduler.py` was computing "today" using the UTC date of the check window instead of the event's local timezone date. This caused late-night events that cross over UTC midnight to be scheduled on the wrong day.

I've fixed the bug by converting the UTC start and end windows to the event's local timezone to determine the exact local dates that fall within the window, and creating candidate occurrences based on those dates. 

Running `./test.sh` now confirms that all timezone scheduling tests (including the failing cross-midnight cases) pass successfully.
